name: Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set of the Repetition-Free Teaching Separation Class
proof: The effective VC radius is two, so every coordinate order has an order-shattered two-set. Standard downshifting in the coordinate order $(4,2,0,1,3)$ produces a downset whose largest face has size two. Thus the minimum over orders is exactly two; all 120 orders are checked in $\texttt{sync/verify\_repetitionfree\_teaching.py}$.
